text: Tell me about a project where you integrated a language model into a backend service. What was your own part in it?

strongSignals: Names concrete design choices and why
weakSignals: Describes only team work without own role

text: Your service starts returning 503 errors at peak traffic. How would you investigate and fix it?

keyPoints: Proposes a concrete fix and verification
weakSignals: Jumps to a fix without investigation

text: How would you explain the limits of an AI feature to a product manager who expects it to be always right?

keyPoints: Explains the limitation in plain language
